column3: the whole row is unreadable: the cluster console — GET /api/held and GET /api/backup, which need the row (the field backup, the pointer pointer), — 503 {error: "unavailable"}, not null and not «no copy»

the whole row is unreadable: at a move (P/08.8 N1.8 step 5) a neighbour at which it does not read answers GET /api/held with 503 {error: "unavailable"} — the move counts it as «did not answer» and skips it; its own unreadable row (its own store is read directly) — not a source, like its own unreadable domain/backup

the whole row is unreadable: the agent — the report object is not taken: the agent does not send it in objects and does not name it in deleted — the holder keeps the previous value (N1.2 member_objects; at the holder — carry «the member's pointer exists and ≠ its domain/backup-taken», P/08.8 N1.5 carry); a whole publication (base 0) with such an object is not sent (P/09.1 N3 «the agent pass» step 3); the write of the row after a taken document (N1.9 member) over an unreadable one — the agent — the only writer — rewrites it by CAS on the version read with the new value, the cause goes to the log; a comparison with the unreadable read value — «differs» → a write
